sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: release-tracks: the "Recording of work" cell rendered completely empty when the credited work currently has open/pending edits on musicbrainz.org. MusicBrainz wraps the work anchor one level deeper in its own native `<span class="mp">` open-edits marker in that case, which the `:scope > a` direct-child lookup didn't accept — the lookup now filters by `href^="/work/"` instead (mirroring `_recordedAtDdAnchor`'s existing fix for the equivalent name-variation-wrapping case), and clones the wrapping `<span class="mp">`/`<span class="name-variation">` (via the new shared `_outerCreditAnchorWrapper()`) so the pending-edits highlight survives into the cell too.

release-tracks: a track's own Title cell silently lost its pending-edits highlight (the recording name itself still rendered) whenever that recording currently has open/pending edits — the Title-cell rebuild in `applyExtractTrackTitleData()` moved back only the bare recording `<a>`, discarding the `<span class="mp">` wrapper it came from.

release-tracks: Performer/Vocals/Instruments/engineer-mixer-etc. credit columns (`_buildCreditListItem()`/`_buildInstrumentVocalsListItem()`) silently lost the pending-edits highlight for a credited artist with open/pending edits — the name rendered correctly either way, only the `<span class="mp">` marker was dropped from the clone.

release-tracks: the millisecond-length WS2 backfill (`_msStampFullReleaseRows()`) silently skipped a row entirely when that row's own recording currently has open/pending edits — its `:scope > a[href*="/recording/"]` lookup found nothing once the Title-cell fix above started preserving the `<span class="mp">` wrapper, so the row never got backfilled to millisecond precision even though the WS2 answer for it had arrived. New shared `_titleRecordingAnchor()` tolerates the wrapper while keeping the existing direct-child scoping (still required to avoid matching a nested `/recording/` link from an unrelated relationship like "DJ-mix of").
